True def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if h % 2 == 1:
        r = h // 2
        if grid[r][0] != 0 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            upper, lower = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ar, br)]
                    for ar, br in zip(upper, lower)]
    if w % 2 == 1:
        c = w // 2
        vals = [row[c] for row in grid]
        if vals[0] != 0 and len(set(vals)) == 1:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ar, br)]
                    for ar, br in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('no centered separator')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if h % 2 == 1:
        r = h // 2
        if grid[r][0] != 0 and len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            upper, lower = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ar, br)]
                    for ar, br in zip(upper, lower)]
    if w % 2 == 1:
        c = w // 2
        vals = [row[c] for row in grid]
        if vals[0] != 0 and len(set(vals)) == 1:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ar, br)]
                    for ar, br in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('no centered separator')
'''
